84  /**
85   * Calculator for data set reset table scope.
86   */
87  public final class DataSetResetScopeCalculator {
88      
89      private static final CacheOption CACHE_OPTION = new CacheOption(128, 1024L);
90      
91      private static final Map<String, SQLParserEngine> SQL_PARSER_ENGINE_MAP = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
92      
93      private static final Map<String, Collection<String>> RESET_TABLE_NAMES_CACHE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
94      
95      /**
96       * Get reset table names.
97       *
98       * @param testParam test parameter
99       * @return reset table names, or empty collection for full reset fallback
100      */
101     public Collection<String> getResetTableNames(final E2ETestParameter testParam) {
102         return RESET_TABLE_NAMES_CACHE.computeIfAbsent(getResetTableNamesCacheKey(testParam), unused -> calculateResetTableNames(testParam));
103     }
104     
105     private Collection<String> calculateResetTableNames(final E2ETestParameter testParam) {
106         Collection<String> result = new LinkedHashSet<>();
107         if (!addParsedTableNames(result, testParam.getTestCaseContext().getTestCase().getSql(), testParam.getDatabaseType())) {
108             return Collections.emptyList();
109         }
110         for (SQLE2ETestCaseAssertion each : getAssertions(testParam)) {
111             if (!addAssertionScope(result, testParam, each)) {
112                 return Collections.emptyList();
113             }
114         }
115         return result;
116     }
117     
118     private String getResetTableNamesCacheKey(final E2ETestParameter testParam) {
119         StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
120         appendCacheKeyValue(result, testParam.getKey());
121         appendCacheKeyValue(result, testParam.getMode().name());
122         appendCacheKeyValue(result, testParam.getTestCaseContext().getParentPath());
123         appendCacheKeyValue(result, testParam.getTestCaseContext().getTestCase().getSql());
124         for (SQLE2ETestCaseAssertion each : getAssertions(testParam)) {
125             appendAssertionCacheKey(result, each);
126         }
127         return result.toString();
128     }
129     
130     private void appendAssertionCacheKey(final StringBuilder cacheKey, final SQLE2ETestCaseAssertion assertion) {
131         if (null == assertion) {
132             appendCacheKeyValue(cacheKey, "");
133             return;
134         }
135         appendCacheKeyValue(cacheKey, assertion.getExpectedDataFile());
136         appendCacheKeyValue(cacheKey, assertion.getExpectedGeneratedKeyDataFile());
137         appendSQLCacheKey(cacheKey, assertion.getInitialSQL());
138         appendSQLCacheKey(cacheKey, assertion.getAssertionSQL());
139     }
140     
141     private void appendSQLCacheKey(final StringBuilder cacheKey, final SQLE2ETestCaseAssertionSQL sql) {
142         appendCacheKeyValue(cacheKey, null == sql ? "" : sql.getSql());
143     }
144     
145     private void appendCacheKeyValue(final StringBuilder cacheKey, final String value) {
146         String actualValue = null == value ? "" : value;
147         cacheKey.append(actualValue.length()).append(':').append(actualValue);
148     }
149     
150     private boolean addAssertionScope(final Collection<String> tableNames, final E2ETestParameter testParam, final SQLE2ETestCaseAssertion assertion) {
151         if (null == assertion) {
152             return true;
153         }
154         if (!addSQLTableNames(tableNames, assertion.getInitialSQL(), testParam.getDatabaseType()) || !addSQLTableNames(tableNames, assertion.getAssertionSQL(), testParam.getDatabaseType())) {
155             return false;
156         }
157         return addDataSetTableNames(tableNames, testParam, assertion.getExpectedDataFile());
158     }
159     
160     private Collection<SQLE2ETestCaseAssertion> getAssertions(final E2ETestParameter testParam) {
161         if (testParam instanceof AssertionTestParameter) {
162             return Collections.singleton(((AssertionTestParameter) testParam).getAssertion());
163         }
164         if (testParam instanceof CaseTestParameter) {
165             return testParam.getTestCaseContext().getTestCase().getAssertions();
166         }
167         return Collections.emptyList();
168     }
169     
170     private boolean addSQLTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final SQLE2ETestCaseAssertionSQL sql, final DatabaseType databaseType) {
171         return null == sql || null == sql.getSql() || addParsedTableNames(tableNames, sql.getSql(), databaseType);
172     }
173     
174     private boolean addParsedTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final String sql, final DatabaseType databaseType) {
175         if (null == sql || sql.isEmpty()) {
176             return true;
177         }
178         for (String each : MultiSQLSplitter.split(sql)) {
179             if (!addParsedSingleSQLTableNames(tableNames, each, databaseType)) {
180                 return false;
181             }
182         }
183         return true;
184     }
185     
186     private boolean addParsedSingleSQLTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final String sql, final DatabaseType databaseType) {
187         try {
188             SQLStatement sqlStatement = getSQLParserEngine(databaseType).parse(sql, true);
189             if (isUnextractedWithSQL(sql, sqlStatement)) {
190                 return false;
191             }
192             Collection<String> virtualTableNames = new LinkedHashSet<>();
193             Collection<String> parsedTableNames = new LinkedHashSet<>();
194             TableExtractor tableExtractor = new TableExtractor();
195             tableExtractor.extractTablesFromSQLStatement(sqlStatement);
196             addExtractedRewriteTableNames(parsedTableNames, tableExtractor);
197             tableExtractor.getTableContext().forEach(each -> addVirtualTableNames(virtualTableNames, each));
198             addSupplementalTableNames(parsedTableNames, virtualTableNames, sqlStatement);
199             removeVirtualTableNames(parsedTableNames, virtualTableNames);
200             tableNames.addAll(parsedTableNames);
201             return true;
202         } catch (final SQLParsingException | ParseCancellationException | DialectSQLParsingException ignored) {
203             return isTransactionControlSQL(sql);
204         }
205     }
206     
207     private void addSupplementalTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final SQLStatement sqlStatement) {
208         if (sqlStatement instanceof InsertStatement) {
209             addInsertStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, (InsertStatement) sqlStatement);
210         } else if (sqlStatement instanceof UpdateStatement) {
211             addUpdateStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, (UpdateStatement) sqlStatement);
212         } else if (sqlStatement instanceof DeleteStatement) {
213             addDeleteStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, (DeleteStatement) sqlStatement);
214         } else if (sqlStatement instanceof MergeStatement) {
215             addMergeStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, (MergeStatement) sqlStatement);
216         } else if (sqlStatement instanceof SelectStatement) {
217             addSelectStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, (SelectStatement) sqlStatement);
218         } else if (sqlStatement instanceof CreateTableStatement) {
219             addCreateTableStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, (CreateTableStatement) sqlStatement);
220         }
221     }
222     
223     private void addCreateTableStatementTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final CreateTableStatement createTableStatement) {
224         createTableStatement.getSelectStatement().ifPresent(optional -> {
225             TableExtractor tableExtractor = new TableExtractor();
226             tableExtractor.extractTablesFromSelect(optional);
227             tableExtractor.getTableContext().forEach(each -> addVirtualTableNames(virtualTableNames, each));
228             addSelectStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional);
229             addExtractedRewriteTableNames(tableNames, tableExtractor);
230         });
231     }
232     
233     private void addSelectStatementTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final SelectStatement selectStatement) {
234         selectStatement.getWith().ifPresent(optional -> addWithTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
235     }
236     
237     private void addInsertStatementTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final InsertStatement insertStatement) {
238         insertStatement.getTable().ifPresent(optional -> addTableSegmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
239         insertStatement.getInsertSelect().ifPresent(optional -> addSubqueryTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
240         insertStatement.getWith().ifPresent(optional -> addWithTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
241         insertStatement.getMultiTableInsertInto().ifPresent(optional -> addMultiTableInsertIntoTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
242         insertStatement.getMultiTableConditionalInto().ifPresent(optional -> addMultiTableConditionalIntoTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
243         insertStatement.getValues().forEach(each -> addInsertValuesTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, each));
244         insertStatement.getSetAssignment().ifPresent(optional -> addSetAssignmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
245         insertStatement.getOnDuplicateKeyColumns().ifPresent(optional -> addOnDuplicateKeyColumnsTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
246     }
247     
248     private void addUpdateStatementTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final UpdateStatement updateStatement) {
249         addTableSegmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, updateStatement.getTable());
250         updateStatement.getFrom().ifPresent(optional -> addTableSegmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
251         updateStatement.getWith().ifPresent(optional -> addWithTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
252         updateStatement.getAssignment().ifPresent(optional -> addSetAssignmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
253     }
254     
255     private void addDeleteStatementTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final DeleteStatement deleteStatement) {
256         addTableSegmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, deleteStatement.getTable());
257         deleteStatement.getWith().ifPresent(optional -> addWithTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
258     }
259     
260     private void addMergeStatementTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final MergeStatement mergeStatement) {
261         addTableSegmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, mergeStatement.getTarget());
262         addTableSegmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, mergeStatement.getSource());
263         mergeStatement.getUpdate().ifPresent(optional -> addUpdateStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
264         mergeStatement.getInsert().ifPresent(optional -> addInsertStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
265         mergeStatement.getWith().ifPresent(optional -> addWithTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
266     }
267     
268     private void addMultiTableInsertIntoTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final MultiTableInsertIntoSegment insertIntoSegment) {
269         insertIntoSegment.getInsertStatements().forEach(each -> addInsertStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, each));
270     }
271     
272     private void addMultiTableConditionalIntoTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames,
273                                                         final MultiTableConditionalIntoSegment conditionalIntoSegment) {
274         conditionalIntoSegment.getWhenThenSegments()
275                 .forEach(each -> each.getThenSegment().getInsertStatements().forEach(optional -> addInsertStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional)));
276         conditionalIntoSegment.getElseSegment().ifPresent(optional -> optional.getInsertStatements().forEach(each -> addInsertStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, each)));
277     }
278     
279     private void addInsertValuesTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final InsertValuesSegment valuesSegment) {
280         addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, valuesSegment.getValues());
281     }
282     
283     private void addSetAssignmentTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final SetAssignmentSegment setAssignmentSegment) {
284         addColumnAssignmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, setAssignmentSegment.getAssignments());
285     }
286     
287     private void addOnDuplicateKeyColumnsTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final OnDuplicateKeyColumnsSegment onDuplicateKeyColumnsSegment) {
288         addColumnAssignmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, onDuplicateKeyColumnsSegment.getColumns());
289     }
290     
291     private void addColumnAssignmentTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final Collection<ColumnAssignmentSegment> assignments) {
292         assignments.forEach(each -> addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, each.getValue()));
293     }
294     
295     private void addExpressionTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final Collection<ExpressionSegment> expressionSegments) {
296         expressionSegments.forEach(each -> addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, each));
297     }
298     
299     private void addExpressionTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final ExpressionSegment expressionSegment) {
300         if (null == expressionSegment) {
301             return;
302         }
303         if (expressionSegment instanceof SubquerySegment) {
304             addSubqueryTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, (SubquerySegment) expressionSegment);
305         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof SubqueryExpressionSegment) {
306             addSubqueryTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((SubqueryExpressionSegment) expressionSegment).getSubquery());
307         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof ExistsSubqueryExpression) {
308             addSubqueryTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((ExistsSubqueryExpression) expressionSegment).getSubquery());
309         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof QuantifySubqueryExpression) {
310             addSubqueryTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((QuantifySubqueryExpression) expressionSegment).getSubquery());
311         } else {
312             addNestedExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, expressionSegment);
313         }
314     }
315     
316     private void addNestedExpressionTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final ExpressionSegment expressionSegment) {
317         if (expressionSegment instanceof BinaryOperationExpression) {
318             BinaryOperationExpression binaryOperationExpression = (BinaryOperationExpression) expressionSegment;
319             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, binaryOperationExpression.getLeft());
320             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, binaryOperationExpression.getRight());
321         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof FunctionSegment) {
322             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((FunctionSegment) expressionSegment).getParameters());
323         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof ListExpression) {
324             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((ListExpression) expressionSegment).getItems());
325         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof RowExpression) {
326             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((RowExpression) expressionSegment).getItems());
327         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof InExpression) {
328             InExpression inExpression = (InExpression) expressionSegment;
329             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, inExpression.getLeft());
330             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, inExpression.getRight());
331         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof BetweenExpression) {
332             BetweenExpression betweenExpression = (BetweenExpression) expressionSegment;
333             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, betweenExpression.getLeft());
334             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, betweenExpression.getBetweenExpr());
335             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, betweenExpression.getAndExpr());
336         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof CaseWhenExpression) {
337             addCaseWhenTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, (CaseWhenExpression) expressionSegment);
338         } else {
339             addOtherExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, expressionSegment);
340         }
341     }
342     
343     private void addCaseWhenTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final CaseWhenExpression caseWhenExpression) {
344         addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, caseWhenExpression.getCaseExpr());
345         addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, caseWhenExpression.getWhenExprs());
346         addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, caseWhenExpression.getThenExprs());
347         addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, caseWhenExpression.getElseExpr());
348     }
349     
350     private void addOtherExpressionTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final ExpressionSegment expressionSegment) {
351         if (expressionSegment instanceof TypeCastExpression) {
352             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((TypeCastExpression) expressionSegment).getExpression());
353         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof UnaryOperationExpression) {
354             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((UnaryOperationExpression) expressionSegment).getExpression());
355         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof NotExpression) {
356             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((NotExpression) expressionSegment).getExpression());
357         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof CollateExpression) {
358             ((CollateExpression) expressionSegment).getExpr().ifPresent(optional -> addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, optional));
359         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof ValuesExpression) {
360             ((ValuesExpression) expressionSegment).getRowConstructorList().forEach(each -> addInsertValuesTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, each));
361         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof KeyValueSegment) {
362             KeyValueSegment keyValueSegment = (KeyValueSegment) expressionSegment;
363             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, keyValueSegment.getKey());
364             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, keyValueSegment.getValue());
365         } else if (expressionSegment instanceof ColumnAssignmentSegment) {
366             addExpressionTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((ColumnAssignmentSegment) expressionSegment).getValue());
367         }
368     }
369     
370     private void addWithTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final WithSegment withSegment) {
371         for (CommonTableExpressionSegment each : withSegment.getCommonTableExpressions()) {
372             each.getAliasName().ifPresent(optional -> virtualTableNames.add(optional.toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH)));
373             addSubqueryTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, each.getSubquery());
374         }
375     }
376     
377     private void addTableSegmentTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final TableSegment tableSegment) {
378         addVirtualTableNames(virtualTableNames, tableSegment);
379         if (tableSegment instanceof SimpleTableSegment) {
380             addTableName(tableNames, (SimpleTableSegment) tableSegment);
381         } else if (tableSegment instanceof JoinTableSegment) {
382             JoinTableSegment joinTableSegment = (JoinTableSegment) tableSegment;
383             addTableSegmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, joinTableSegment.getLeft());
384             addTableSegmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, joinTableSegment.getRight());
385         } else if (tableSegment instanceof SubqueryTableSegment) {
386             addSubqueryTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, ((SubqueryTableSegment) tableSegment).getSubquery());
387         } else if (tableSegment instanceof DeleteMultiTableSegment) {
388             DeleteMultiTableSegment deleteMultiTableSegment = (DeleteMultiTableSegment) tableSegment;
389             deleteMultiTableSegment.getActualDeleteTables().forEach(each -> addTableName(tableNames, each));
390             addTableSegmentTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, deleteMultiTableSegment.getRelationTable());
391         }
392     }
393     
394     private void addSubqueryTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final SubquerySegment subquerySegment) {
395         if (null != subquerySegment.getSelect()) {
396             TableExtractor tableExtractor = new TableExtractor();
397             tableExtractor.extractTablesFromSelect(subquerySegment.getSelect());
398             tableExtractor.getTableContext().forEach(each -> addVirtualTableNames(virtualTableNames, each));
399             addSelectStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, subquerySegment.getSelect());
400             addExtractedRewriteTableNames(tableNames, tableExtractor);
401         }
402         if (null != subquerySegment.getMerge()) {
403             addMergeStatementTableNames(tableNames, virtualTableNames, subquerySegment.getMerge());
404         }
405     }
406     
407     private void addExtractedRewriteTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final TableExtractor tableExtractor) {
408         for (SimpleTableSegment each : tableExtractor.getRewriteTables()) {
409             addTableName(tableNames, each);
410         }
411     }
412     
413     private void addTableName(final Collection<String> tableNames, final SimpleTableSegment tableSegment) {
414         tableNames.add(tableSegment.getTableName().getIdentifier().getValue());
415     }
416     
417     private void addVirtualTableNames(final Collection<String> virtualTableNames, final TableSegment tableSegment) {
418         if (tableSegment instanceof SimpleTableSegment) {
419             SimpleTableSegment simpleTableSegment = (SimpleTableSegment) tableSegment;
420             simpleTableSegment.getAliasName().filter(optional -> !optional.equalsIgnoreCase(simpleTableSegment.getTableName().getIdentifier().getValue()))
421                     .ifPresent(optional -> virtualTableNames.add(optional.toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH)));
422         } else if (tableSegment instanceof JoinTableSegment) {
423             JoinTableSegment joinTableSegment = (JoinTableSegment) tableSegment;
424             joinTableSegment.getAliasName().ifPresent(optional -> virtualTableNames.add(optional.toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH)));
425             addVirtualTableNames(virtualTableNames, joinTableSegment.getLeft());
426             addVirtualTableNames(virtualTableNames, joinTableSegment.getRight());
427         } else if (tableSegment instanceof SubqueryTableSegment) {
428             tableSegment.getAliasName().ifPresent(optional -> virtualTableNames.add(optional.toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH)));
429         }
430     }
431     
432     private void removeVirtualTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final Collection<String> virtualTableNames) {
433         tableNames.removeIf(each -> virtualTableNames.contains(each.toLowerCase(Locale.ENGLISH)));
434     }
435     
436     private boolean isUnextractedWithSQL(final String sql, final SQLStatement sqlStatement) {
437         return sql.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ENGLISH).startsWith("WITH") && !containsWithSegment(sqlStatement);
438     }
439     
440     private boolean containsWithSegment(final SQLStatement sqlStatement) {
441         if (sqlStatement instanceof SelectStatement) {
442             return ((SelectStatement) sqlStatement).getWith().isPresent();
443         }
444         if (sqlStatement instanceof InsertStatement) {
445             return ((InsertStatement) sqlStatement).getWith().isPresent();
446         }
447         if (sqlStatement instanceof UpdateStatement) {
448             return ((UpdateStatement) sqlStatement).getWith().isPresent();
449         }
450         if (sqlStatement instanceof DeleteStatement) {
451             return ((DeleteStatement) sqlStatement).getWith().isPresent();
452         }
453         return sqlStatement instanceof MergeStatement && ((MergeStatement) sqlStatement).getWith().isPresent();
454     }
455     
456     private boolean isTransactionControlSQL(final String sql) {
457         String trimSQL = sql.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ENGLISH);
458         return trimSQL.startsWith("BEGIN") || trimSQL.startsWith("COMMIT") || trimSQL.startsWith("ROLLBACK") || trimSQL.startsWith("START TRANSACTION")
459                 || trimSQL.startsWith("SAVEPOINT") || trimSQL.startsWith("RELEASE SAVEPOINT") || trimSQL.startsWith("SET AUTOCOMMIT");
460     }
461     
462     private SQLParserEngine getSQLParserEngine(final DatabaseType databaseType) {
463         return SQL_PARSER_ENGINE_MAP.computeIfAbsent(databaseType.getType(), unused -> new ShardingSphereSQLParserEngine(databaseType, CACHE_OPTION, CACHE_OPTION));
464     }
465     
466     private boolean addDataSetTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final E2ETestParameter testParam, final String expectedDataFile) {
467         if (null == expectedDataFile) {
468             return true;
469         }
470         try {
471             for (DataSetMetaData each : DataSetLoader.load(testParam.getTestCaseContext().getParentPath(), testParam.getScenario(), testParam.getDatabaseType(), testParam.getMode(), expectedDataFile)
472                     .getMetaDataList()) {
473                 addDataSetMetaDataTableNames(tableNames, each);
474             }
475             return true;
476         } catch (final IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
477             return false;
478         }
479     }
480     
481     private void addDataSetMetaDataTableNames(final Collection<String> tableNames, final DataSetMetaData dataSetMetaData) {
482         if (null != dataSetMetaData.getTableName()) {
483             tableNames.add(dataSetMetaData.getTableName());
484         }
485         for (String each : InlineExpressionParserFactory.newInstance(dataSetMetaData.getDataNodes()).splitAndEvaluate()) {
486             String tableName = new DataNode(each).getTableName();
487             tableNames.add(tableName);
488             tableNames.add(tableName.replaceFirst("_[0-9]+$", ""));
489             tableNames.add(tableName.replaceFirst("[0-9]+$", ""));
490         }
491     }
